name: aera
description: AERA, Advanced Ecosystem of Rail Analytics

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync --group dev --group data && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:twin: cd backend && uv run uvicorn aera_twin.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run --group data pytest -q && uv run python -m pytest -q ../edge/tests && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff check --config pyproject.toml ../edge
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run typecheck
scripts.import:gtfs: cd backend && uv run python -m aera_twin.gtfs.importer --route KJ
scripts.import:network: cd backend && uv run python -m aera_twin.gtfs.network
scripts.import:trains: cd backend && uv run python -m aera_twin.gtfs.trains
scripts.contracts: cd backend && uv run python -m aera_twin.contracts
scripts.model: cd backend && uv run --group data python -m aera_twin.ridership.build
scripts.model:network: cd backend && uv run --group data python -m aera_twin.ridership.network
